tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// ma gcig rdo rje dbang grol ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor bsngo dang thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga bsam don kun 'grub zhes bya ba bzhugs// dpal ldan bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas// kun 'dus bdag nyid pad+ma ka ra la// gus pas btud de skyu ra zhes bya ba'i// gnas bdag lha mo'i gtor bsngo bskang ba bri// de la sbyor ba sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gtor ma zlum gtor rgyan ldan dang*/ bskang gso dang 'brel na gtor ma snying gzugs rgyan ldan dang ji ltar 'byor pa'i mchod pa bsham mo// gnyis pa la/ bskang ba bshags pa bzlog pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ thog mar gtor bsngo la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yi nang gtor ma lha yi zhal zas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ rang yi dam lhar gsal ba'i mdun du bh+rūm̐ las khang bzang rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i sgo rgyan rta babs rgya phibs tog dang bcas pa'i nang du rin po che'i khri dar sna tshogs kyis bkab pa'i steng du/ māṃ las ma gcig rdo rje dbang grol ma sku mdog ston zla ltar dkar zhing zhal 'dzum khro sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba myu gu cung zad gtsigs shing spyan gnyis g.yo ba/ phyag g.yas pas srid zhi'i phywa g.yang thams cad 'gugs pa'i mda' dar dang*/ g.yon pas dgos 'dod dngos grub 'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor bu bsnams pa/ sku la dar dkar gyi na bza' dang dbu skra ral pa 'phyang zhing thod skam dang nyi zlas brgyan pa/ rin po che'i snyan cha la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i rol stabs su bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'jigs rung dur khrod kyi gnas dang bsam yas shing drung sogs gang na gnas pa nas/ ma gcig rdo rje dbang grol ma 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma kā ra dang kun dga' rin chen la sogs pa rgyal sras rig pa 'dzin pa gang dag byon pa rnams kyi bka' lung rjes su dran pas ljongs 'di'i 'khor yug kun tu rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bstan pa bstan 'dzin dge 'dun gyi tshogs 'phel rgyas su 'byung zhing bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dri ma med pa dar ba dang*/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen gang dag byon bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las stong grogs mdzod cig ces brjod la/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ e ka ma tā badz+ra wa shaṃ muk+ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa sogs gsum mam bdun gyis bsngos la/ mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul// rnam 'dren bstan pa srung zhing bstan 'dzin gyi// bar chad bsal nas bshad sgrub dar ba dang*// gang bcol bsam don sgrub la mthu ldan ma// rdo rje dbang grol 'khor dang bcas la bstod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyis phrin las bcol lo// gnyis pa bskang ba la/ bskang rdzas bsang sbyangs gong ltar dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/

gzhan yang bskang rdzas spyan gzigs dkor nor la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis bar dang*/ oṃ sarba bita pu ra pu ra sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hās rgyas par spel/ de nas rnga rol dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ chos dang chos mdzad srung ma mngon dga' zhing*// rnal 'byor bsam don sgrub la rdzu 'phrul dang*// mthu stobs dpag yas rdo rje dbang grol ma// 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas 'bul ba ni// mchod yon rgya mtsho 'dab brgya'i me tog tshal// dri zhim bdug spos snang gsal sgron me'i phreng*// bsung ldan yon chab legs bris zhal zas dang*// rnga dung rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*// yid 'ong gzugs mchog snyan 'jebs sgra dang dri// ro brgya'i bza' dang bca' ba ji snyed dang*// stong 'khun dar gos brgya byin tshon gyi sbun// lo tog legs par smin pa'i 'bru rigs dang*// rin chen gser dngul mu tig sbur len shel// byi ru g.yu dang rgya ja dkar mngar ro// 'dod 'jo'i ba sogs bzhon ma rta phyugs tshogs// ri skyes bu dang bu mo 'dab ldan rigs// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas ye shes kyi// bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa'i ba lin+ta// ja chang phud kyi btung ba ji snyed kyis// ma gcig rdo rje dbang grol thugs dam bskang*// rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang*// las kyi rigs su gtogs pa'i ma mo dang*// mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs kun gyi thugs dam bskang*// khyed rnams thugs dam gnyen po bskangs gyur nas// rnal 'byor bdag gi zhi rgyas dbang gi las// gang brtsams gegs med 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba'i phrin las sgyu 'phrul 'jig rten pa'i// mkha' 'gro'i tshul gyis bstan pa skyong mdzad pa// de ltar ma rtogs mchod gtor chag pa sogs// thugs dang 'gal dgu bzod par mdzad du gsol// gsum pa ni/

bh+yo ma gcig mkha' 'gro rdo rje dbang grol ma// rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i sde tshogs thams cad dang*// sprul pa yang sprul gnam sa'i khyon gang ba// thams cad las la bskul lo mthu ma chung*// bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi// lo zla zhag dus rtsub pa'i keg dang sri// phyi nang 'byung 'khrug nad dang dus min 'chi// sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i gdon tshogs kyi// nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad bzlog cig bsgyur// sdang shing gdug pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa yi// rbad zor byad gtad 'khrul 'khor gang brtsams pa// khyed cag mthu rtsal drag po'i 'thor rlung gis// phyir bzlog byad ma de de'i shed du phob// ltas ngan brgyad cu ye 'drogs thams cad dang*// rmi lam mi shis mtshan ltas gang byung ba// tsher ma'i nags la bskal pa'i me lces bzhin// 'bras bu mi 'byin thal bar brlag mdzod cig /mthu stobs dpag yas mi shigs rdo rje yis// bsrung ba'i gur khyim yangs par bdag cag rnams// chos dang srid pa'i bde 'byor phun tshogs la// dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i skal bzang la sbyor cig /thun gtor yod na gser skyems dang bcas pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐ bh+yo 'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i gnas rnams dang*// bsam yas gtsug lag khang dang sgrub gnas sogs// gar bzhugs gnas nas rdo rje dbang grol ma// rigs bzhi'i ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khor tshogs bcas// 'dir gshegs rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang*// gser skyems phud kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bdag cag 'khor bcas dgos pa la la'i phyir// gzhir sdod byes bgrod rnam pa thams cad du// kha 'dzin rgyab brten dpung grogs ma g.yel bar// mi mthun nyes brgya'i phyogs las bsrung ba dang*// ci 'dod legs pa'i dpal dang legs sbyor ba'i// bsam pa'i don kun 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod// ces brjod la/

thun gtor phyi rol du dor zhing gser skyems nam mkha' la gtor ro// gtor chog sogs gzhan dang 'brel ba'am ma 'brel yang rung ste/ spro na/ bskang gso dang 'brel tshe rol mo dang bcas te/ hūm̐ dzam bu ljon pas mtshan pa'i gling mchog gi /'jigs rung dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad sogs// gar bzhugs gnas nas rdo rje dbang grol ma// 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// bod yul dbus gyur 'chang ba bsam yas kyi// gtsug lag khang dang shing drung nags tshal sogs// ma mo mkha' 'gro rab dgas bsti ba'i gnas// gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas nas da tshur spyon// bod chen ljongs kyi nor 'dzin thig le 'dir// kun rin la sogs grub dbang gang byon gyi// bka' lung phrin yig rjes su dran byos la// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir thogs med gshegs su gsol// oṃ e ka ma ta wa shaṃ muk+ti sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi zhes brjod/ gang ltar yang*/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod pa'i skabs yin na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam zhing*/ gnas srung ba sogs bdag gi rnal 'byor gang yin gyi mjug bsdus te/ dge ba bsngo ba dang bkra shis smon lam gyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'di sbyar dge ba zla 'od gsar pa yis// 'jig rten dge legs sa dga'i me tog tshal// rnam par rgyas pa'i phan bde'i ro bcud la// lus can tsa ko ra tshogs spyod gyur cig /ces ma gcig rdo rje dbang grol ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor bsngo dang thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga bsam don kun 'grub zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dbon bla ma kun dga' grags pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung me zla'i zla tshes dge bar lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i ba gam du bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/

// ༄༅// bstan srung tshogs la gtor bsngo brgya rtsa 'bring po bsag tshul bzhugs so// ༄༅// 'dir gtor bsngo brgya rtsa 'bring po zhig bsag pa'i tshul ni/ sngar gyi gtor ma rnying pa lnga tshar yod na de la mtheb kyu gsar pa bsabs/ med na gsar pa zhig kyang bshams te/ gsar rnying gang yin de'i mdun du bsag rgyu'i zlum gtor lnga dang de'i mdun nyer spyod bshams/ de nas bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ lnga tshar gsar rnying gang yin de thod pa byin brlab bya ba dang*/ yi dam nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi bar gtor chog ltar phul/ yi dam bsnyen pa cung zad sngon du 'gro ba'i chos skyong rnams kyi bzlas bshags sngon du btang la/ mdun gyi cog zlum lnga la mtheb kyu gnyis re bsabs te thod pa byin rlabs rgyas pa tshar gcig byas la/ thog mar gur mgon lcam dral la bsags na/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs lan gsum dang*/ shā sa na lan gsum/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā li de wi sogs lha mo'i sngags lan gsum gyis phul mthar/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de w+yai sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ro ru sogs lha mo'i sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod dang rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog sogs dkyus ltar la khyad par rang rang gi dmigs bsal dgos pa cung zad btags na'ang legs/ bstod pa hūm̐ yig ma lha mo'i bstod pa 'phrin bcol bcas thog mtha' gnyis su rgyas pa bya/ bar skabs rnams su hūm̐ yig ma'am srin gzugs ma sh+lau ka gcig gang gi sku gsung thugs ma sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha hoḥhrīḥbyin rlabs dran tsam byas la/ yang lcam dral sngags kyis gong ltar phul nas bstod bsdus bcas cog re la lan gnyis re bsngos pas tshar bcu 'gro// slar yang mtheb kyu gnyis re bsabs te thod pa byin rlabs rgyas pa re'i mthar tshar bcu 'bul te de lta bu lan bcu gcig la gnyis chag byas pas brgya dang brgyad kyi bar du bsags/

des lcam dral la bsags zin nas/ yang zhal la cog lnga gsar pa yod na bshams la/ yang de la mtheb kyu gnyis re bsabs te bcu re'i sngon du thod pa byin rlabs rgyas pa re bya/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la sogs gsum dang*/ phyi nang mchod pa dang 'dod gsol dkyus ltar dang*/ thog mthar bstod pa gsar rnying gang rung ltar rgyas pa dang bar skabs rnams su dpal ldan dbang ldan sogs sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod do// de'i rigs bsgres te bstan srung ci tsam la bsags na'ang 'dra'o// mtha' spyi bstabs sogs dkyus ltar brtan bzhugs bkra shis yan byas pas grub bo// 'di ni gtor bsngo 'bring po bsags pa'i lugs so// shin tu bsdus pa ni lnga tshar mdun gyi cog zlum lnga po de la lan gnyis re yang yang bsab pa chos skyong thams cad la des 'thus pa byed pa 'dra lags/ tshul rin gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
